body:
Two freinds brought over 4 white 10mg ambiens tonight around 11:15. We all crushed our tablets, and got them lined up. We each snorted one, and the friedn who brought them snorted 2. We all stood up and instantly felt the effects. A rush of calm euphoria spread throughout my body, and I felt a bit drunk. We called up a guy who has lots of Rx stuff, and we drove to him and got 3 more ambiens, which the three of us split. Finally, we arrived home and stole 3 more from my friend's dad. We took these.
Now, the hallucinations ran RAMPANT on my walk home. The road seemed to lift me up and roll me around. the phone started wiggling. then the entire ROOM started to lift on an angle, and I tried holding onto my chair, yet I couldn't resist the angle, and i fell out of my chair, only to find that the room was normal...
Anyway, more streange hallucinations twisted their ways into my mind that night.
